# Recorded Scenario MCP replies

Recorded from the hosted Scenario MCP (server 0.34.0) on 2026-10-18 with free calls only (schema reads, dry runs, a free upload), then scrubbed: ids, signed links and account fields are replaced with placeholders. Job rows are shaped from real replies with placeholder ids.

`tests/fake_backend/fake_scenario.py` serves them; `tools/contract_check.py` checks weekly that the live server still answers this way.
